spans.s: The third short vowel of the Sanskrit alphabet, corresponding to the letter U, and pronounced as that is in the word full.

r. 1st cl. (उ) उङ (उवते)
To sound, to make a particular sound or noise.
The sixth vowel of the Sanscrit alphabet, corresponding to U long, and having the sound of that letter in the word rule.

ind.
1 An incipient particle.
2 An interjection of compassion.
3 Of regard.
m. (ऊः)
The moon.
E.
अव to go, क्विप् affix, व becomes ऊ.
